baseline.tier1_caveat: Probe constructs BubblewrapLauncher but invokes command() then ProcessBuilder directly, bypassing launch() solver hash and second BuildIdentity scan. Its201..203ms total is not a full fenced-worker total; constructor scan is present. Output check only verifies VALIDATED substring, not semantic equality.

options.candidate: Advisory-only TieredStopAtLevel=1 with existing launcher path intact
options.feasibility: One extra JVM flag preserves fresh process/classloader/static isolation. Existing isolated exchange observations justify a separately frozen measurement candidate; no target claim.
options.risks: Compilation tradeoff can hurt larger SOURCE/BLOCK/invalid cases; do not apply solver-wide without separate evidence. Current exploratory total omits launch fences.
required_tests: Use actual BubblewrapLauncher.launch with both full scans and solver pin; add flag only for fixed document advisory entry point.
Compare complete normalized outputs, classifications and limits across46constructor cases, max512nodes/depth32/source32KiB, malformed and TEXT_ONLY inputs.

options.candidate: Read-only CDS verification, then separately pinned AppCDS jar packaging if worthwhile
options.feasibility: Local Ubuntu JDK17.0.20.1 provides default classes.jsa and classes_nocoops.jsa. Installed java(1) documents -Xshare:auto default; current command does not disable it, so default CDS may already apply. Observe archive use before claiming any gain. AppCDS needs a packaged application jar: current /app/classes nonempty directory conflicts with documented CDS classpath restrictions.
options.risks: Archive is executable runtime input. Current BuildIdentity only hashes dependency *.jar and classes files; a new external .jsa must be explicitly pinned/bound, not silently excluded. Archive loading depends on JDK/flags/classpath; packaging may change resource/service lookup or wildcard jar order. Default archive mapping under2GiBAS not yet verified. No reusable user AST or prior result may enter an archive.
required_tests: Freeze exact JDK, flags, deterministic jar entry/resource manifest, ordered explicit classpath and archive digest; preserve full original logical classes/static/dependency identity scans plus archive binding.
Generate only from synthetic nonprivate training input in isolated build tooling; runtime never dumps archives or writes into installation.

Verify actual shared-object class-load evidence under existing sandbox/caps; compare missing/mutated/incompatible archive policy and fresh-process outputs. Do not treat CRC32 VerifySharedSpaces as a security hash.
Installed manual warns -Xshare:on is test-only; contract must choose explicit production compatibility/fallback behavior without bypassing validation or full identity checks.
Measure package/archive creation separately and actual full fenced one-shot HTTP runtime before selecting.

options.candidate: Advisory-only compact worker reply after unchanged full validation
options.feasibility: Observed worker response is257511bytes. DocumentEngine.bounded encodes full result then deepCopies it; DocumentWorkerMain encodes envelope again; parent decodes full artifact, but validationReply only uses diagnostics, idRemapping for inverse mapping, mode, source and sourceHash. Full artifact/module/occurrences/trivia/command transfer may be unnecessary for advisory after independent checks complete.
options.risks: Public/durable wire semantics must remain unchanged; do not remove base integrity, roundtrip, copy/remap or ownership validation. Keep original full-result size rejection policy if preserving accepted-domain semantics. Projection must retain inverse-remapped diagnostics and exact source/hash.
required_tests: Freeze a distinct private advisory opcode/schema while commit/history keep existing full worker result and one-shot reaping.
Compare exact public advisory responses across all modes/invalidations/identity cases and1MiB/diagnostic bounds.
Measure isolated encode/decode/copy and pipe time before claiming savings;257KiB alone does not establish large latency cost.

options.candidate: Eliminate duplicate serialization/copies only where request-local ownership is proved
options.feasibility: Parent copies candidate/base/inventory into frame; worker decodes fresh tree, DocumentEngine deepCopies candidate/base/inventory, bounds via serialization and copies result before outer serialization. A separately reviewed ownership contract could allow private request-owned nodes and bounded single-pass output encoding.
options.risks: Removing copies without mutation audit can change original draft/base/inventory and diagnostic provenance. A single bounded outer stream may change the exact full-result versus envelope size boundary.
required_tests: Audit mutating ObjectNode/ArrayNode operations and prove ownership at each removed copy; retain immutability tests.
Freeze exact framing/size/error behavior and inject serialization/overflow/transport failures.
Retain full integrity/ModuleChecker/Alloy roundtrip validation and all BuildIdentity scans; profile allocations and CPU first.

recommendation: Prioritize the separately reviewed combined authorized context operation and advisory-only Tier1 using the full launcher; both preserve one-shot semantic isolation. CDS is an incremental packaging/runtime-input candidate after verifying current default sharing. Compact reply/copy work requires phase evidence and is unlikely to justify target claims from size alone. No combination is proven below300ms; current components cannot be subtracted as percentile guarantees.
